# Ishmael

Ishmael is the narrator. He goes to sea when he has little money and nothing to keep
him on shore.[^moby-dick] He sails on the Pequod under
[Captain Ahab](/wiki/entities/captain-ahab.md).

[^moby-dick]: [Moby-Dick](/sources/classics/moby-dick/moby-dick.md)
